commands.name: /pr
commands.description: Create or update a GitHub Pull Request from the current branch using gh, with a templated body.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: PR body (supports markdown). If omitted, generates from git diff.

arguments.name: base
arguments.description: Base branch to merge into (default: main).

commands.name: /commit
commands.description: Create a conventional commit with a multi-line message via heredoc and show status.

commands.name: /review
commands.description: Summarize current diff and highlight risks, test gaps, and CI considerations.
